blocks.raw:
<ExamTip>
For the LEA, memorize the Philippine PSH range (4.5–5.5) and the PR range (0.75–0.85). Exam questions often give you a daily load and ask you to size a system — plug these values directly into the formula.
</ExamTip>

<Tip>
Use the 2 m² per 400 Wp panel as a quick rule-of-thumb for space planning. A 25 kWp system needs ~125 m² roof area, equivalent to a modest three-story commercial building's rooftop.
</Tip>

<Warn>
Do not confuse the net metering capacity cap. It was raised from 100 kW to 1 MW under ERC Resolution No. 09, Series of 2019. The LEA may test whether you know the current 1 MW limit, not the older 100 kW limit.
</Warn>

blocks.raw:
<Note>
Duty-free import and VAT exemption on PV equipment under RA 9513 (Renewable Energy Act) and DOE implementing rules (DNER 2021-02-0002). Regional electric cooperatives may offer rebates for connected members. Check with local government for property tax holidays on solar installations (some LGUs grant 5–10 year exemptions).

</Note>
